Author: Muse
Description: Exports the logged-in character's job/class levels, Cosmic Exploration progress, gearsets, equipped items, currencies, inventory, retainers, Grand Company supply requests, housing visits, main scenario progress and shared FATE progress to per-character JSON files; records incoming tells; applies plugin configuration files sent by Muse (config downlink); keeps the Halone Earring equipped while leveling. Every feature can be toggled in the plugin's settings window.
Name: Muse Status Exporter
